name: AccessObject
description: An AccessObject object refers to a particular Access object.
remarks: An AccessObject object includes information about one instance of an object. The following table list the types of objects each AccessObject describes, the name of its collection, and what type of information AccessObject contains. Because an AccessObject object corresponds to an existing object, you can't create new AccessObject objects or delete existing ones. To refer to an AccessObject object in a collection by its ordinal number or by its Name property setting, use any of the following syntax forms: - AllForms (0) - AllForms ("name") - AllForms ![ name ]

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Use the Name property to determine the string expression that identifies the name of an object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the value of an AccessObject object type. Read-only AcObjectType.

properties.name: Properties
properties.description: Returns a reference to an AccessObject object's AccessObjectProperties collection. Read-only.

properties.name: IsLoaded
properties.description: Use the IsLoaded property to determine if an AccessObject object is currently loaded. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: FullName
properties.description: Sets or returns the full path (including the file name) of a specific object. Read/write String.

properties.name: DateCreated
properties.description: Returns a Date indicating the date and time when the design of the specified object was last modified. Read-only.

properties.name: DateModified
properties.description: Returns a Date indicating the date and time when the design of the specified object was last modified. Read-only.

properties.name: CurrentView
properties.description: Returns the current view for the specified Access object. Read-only AcCurrentView.

properties.name: IsWeb
properties.description: Gets whether the specified object is a web object. Read-only Boolean.

methods.name: IsDependentUpon
methods.signature: IsDependentUpon(ObjectType As AcObjectType, ObjectName As String) As Boolean
methods.description: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the specified object is dependent upon the database object specified in the ObjectName argument.

parameters.name: ObjectType
parameters.description: An AcObjectType constant that represents the type of database object to check for dependency.

parameters.name: ObjectName
parameters.description: The name of the database object to check for dependency.

methods.name: GetDependencyInfo
methods.description: Returns a DependencyInfo object that represents the database objects that are dependent upon the specified object.
